component.description: Use FeatureFlagged when you only need to show or hide a subtree. It uses the same enabled-state hook and renders nothing when the flag is disabled or unknown.

hook.description: Call useIsFeatureEnabled at the top level of a React component. It returns a boolean and updates the component when that flag changes. Use it when you need the value for conditional rendering or other render-time decisions.

hook.unknown: A flag absent from the store returns false. Call the hook unconditionally, not inside an event handler or conditional branch.
